title: EzyShield config.yaml
description: Main runtime configuration. No secrets may appear here; use env:VARNAME references for any credential field. Mirrors internal/config/config.go — update both together.

secretRef.description: Secret reference. Must be 'env:VARNAME' — inline secrets are forbidden and rejected at load time.

severityList.description: Severity levels to forward on this channel. Empty/omitted means all severities.

name.description: Operator-chosen label to disambiguate accounts in logs. Optional for a single account; required and unique with multiple accounts.

mode.description: Enforcement backend. Empty defaults to 'lists' (account-level Custom IP List); 'rulesets' manages per-zone WAF Custom Rules.

account_id.description: Cloudflare account ID; required when mode is 'lists'.

instance.description: Identity of THIS daemon among several servers sharing one Cloudflare account/list: items are tagged 'ezyshield:<instance>' and each daemon reconciles only its own subset. Defaults to the hostname; must stay stable across restarts.

adopt_legacy_items.description: Adopt list items written before per-instance tagging (bare 'ezyshield' comment) so they expire again. Set on exactly ONE server sharing the account, and remove once legacy items drain.

list_name.description: Custom IP List name for mode 'lists'. Defaults to 'ezyshield_blocked'; auto-created when missing.

zone_ids.description: Zones to manage. Required when mode is 'rulesets'; optional WAF auto-management in 'lists' mode.

debounce.description: Mutation-coalescing window as a Go duration string (e.g. '15s'). Rapid ban/unban mutations batch into one API push per window. Omitted or 0 means the default 15s.

expire_flush_interval.description: Cadence for batched item removals (expired bans, unbans) in 'lists' mode, as a Go duration string (e.g. '3m'). Omitted or 0 means the default 3m. Fail-closed: an expired IP can stay blocked at the edge for up to this long.

data_dir.description: State directory used by the dashboard command (auth DB at <data_dir>/dashboard.db); required by 'config validate'. Does not set the daemon's database path, which comes from the 'run --db' flag.

socket_path.description: Control unix socket path the dashboard connects to. The daemon binds its socket from the 'run --socket' flag, not this key; keep the two in sync.

rules_path.description: DEPRECATED whole-file rule replacement: when set, the file replaces the embedded base entirely and rules.d drop-ins are ignored. Prefer rules_dir drop-ins.

rules_dir.description: Overrides the rules.d drop-in directory (default /etc/ezyshield/rules.d). Drop-ins merge over the embedded base by rule name and survive binary updates.

collectors.description: Log collectors — added after running 'ezyshield init && ezyshield scan'.

path.description: Log file path. Required when kind is 'file'.

unit.description: Systemd unit name. Required when kind is 'journald'.

container.description: Container name, short ID, or full ID. Required when kind is 'docker'.

parser.description: Forces parser selection by prefixing the source ID. Consumed by 'file' (source override) and 'docker' collectors; ignored by 'journald'.

enforce.description: Local and edge enforcement backend settings.

socket.description: Enforcer helper unix socket path. Default /run/ezyshield-enforcer/enforcer.sock.

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare edge enforcement: one account (mapping) or several (sequence of mappings).

ai.description: AI provider settings. Disabled by default. Use the single-provider form (provider + api_key) or the failover form (providers array); providers takes precedence when both are present.

endpoint.description: Base URL for the 'ollama' provider only (default http://localhost:11434). The 'anthropic' and 'openai' providers ignore it and always call their official APIs.

ambiguous_band.description: Score range [low, high] sent to AI; outside this range the rule engine decides. Omitted defaults to [30, 69]. Keep high below the policy ban_threshold: scores at or above the threshold already decide a ban on rules alone and are never sent to the AI (a reaching band triggers a warning).

token_budget_daily.description: Maximum tokens to spend per calendar day.

cache_ttl.description: Verdict cache TTL as a Go duration string (e.g. '15m'). Omitted or 0 means the default 15m; the cache cannot be disabled. Entries are keyed by behavior signature, not IP.

providers.description: Multi-provider failover list; per-entry fields override the parent values when non-zero.

notify.description: Notification channels. All credential fields use env:VARNAME references.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Maximum notifications per channel per minute. Defaults to 5 when omitted or zero.

dedup_window_sec.description: Suppress repeat notifications for the same IP+reason within this window. Defaults to 600 seconds.

notify_only_window_sec.description: Per-(IP, rule) suppression window for notify_only events: the first event notifies immediately, repeats within the window fold into one summary notification. Omitted or 0 = 3600 (1 hour); negative = disabled. Audit log rows are never suppressed.

tls.description: Connection mode: 'starttls' (default, port 587), 'tls' (implicit TLS, port 465), or 'none' (plaintext, not recommended).

channel.description: Overrides the default channel configured in the Slack app (e.g. '#security').

headers.description: Headers sent on every request. Values are sent verbatim unless the entire value is an env: reference, which is resolved.

enrich.description: GeoIP/ASN enrichment via MaxMind MMDB databases.

auto_update.description: Weekly download of fresh MMDB files from MaxMind. Requires license_key.

dashboard.description: Localhost-only web UI. Both fields optional; safe defaults are 127.0.0.1:9090 and <data_dir>/dashboard.db.

addr.description: host:port to bind. Must resolve to a loopback address (127.0.0.1, ::1, or 'localhost') — no 0.0.0.0 escape hatch.

auth_db_path.description: SQLite file storing the admin password hash. Defaults to <data_dir>/dashboard.db.

verified_bots.description: Verified-bot protection (issue #215): forward-confirmed reverse DNS sparing of well-known crawlers from over-eager rules. Absent/disabled = no DNS lookups ever happen. UA alone is never trusted.

enabled.description: Turn the guard on. Built-in providers: googlebot, bingbot, applebot, yandexbot, baiduspider, duckduckbot.

providers.description: Extend or override the built-in provider table, matched by name.

name.description: Provider identifier used in audits; overriding a built-in name replaces that entry.

ua_contains.description: Case-insensitive User-Agent substrings that make an IP a verification candidate.

domains.description: DNS suffixes the PTR name must fall under (dot-anchored match).

retention.description: Data-retention pruning (issue #184). OPT-IN: without this section nothing is ever pruned. Durations use Go syntax plus a day unit ('30d', '365d', '2160h'); 'never' or '0' disables that table. Active bans and the allowlist are never touched.

strikes.description: Window for strike history (default 730d, floor 180d). The newest strike of an IP with an active ban is never deleted; fully-aged offenders reset escalation.

audit.description: Window for the audit journal (default 365d, floor 90d). Deletion additionally requires audit_export_not_required: true.

ai_usage.description: Window for AI cost-accounting rows (default 90d, floor 7d).

i_understand_the_risks.description: Allow windows below the per-table safety floors. A 24h absolute minimum still applies.

audit_export_not_required.description: Acknowledge that audit_log rows will be deleted with no export archiving them. Audit pruning refuses to run while false.

docker_exec.description: Docker exec activity watcher (issue #220): observational post-exploitation signal from the docker events API. Opt-in; NEVER a ban source — observations are audited, streamed to `watch`, and notified only.

enabled.description: Subscribe to exec_start events on the docker socket.

ignore.description: Container-name or image patterns to skip (path.Match globs; plain text matches as substring) — legitimate cron/health tooling.

webshell_watch.description: Webshell-drop tripwire (issue #221): polling watch over web roots for new/modified executable web files. Purely observational — audit + notification, never a ban.

enabled.description: Opt-in switch; false or absent means no filesystem is swept.

roots.description: Absolute web-root directories to sweep (e.g. /var/www/html). Required when enabled.

extensions.description: Watched extensions with leading dot. Default: .php, .phtml, .php5, .php7, .phar.

ignore.description: Path patterns to skip — path.Match globs, or substrings when the pattern has no glob metacharacters (cache/upload dirs that legitimately churn).

interval_sec.description: Sweep cadence in seconds. Default 10; floor 5.
